_comment: __text baseline for the binary-size CI gate (see check_gate.py and .github/workflows/binary_size.yml). Measured osx-arm64, 2026-09-07. Measured against 5a7e368c, the last commit before it: query_dynvalue +315,520 (+3.3%, the erased lane paying for DynValue's mask slot and RuntimeValue's dtype ladder), query_streaming +14,196 (+0.93%), query_scan +81,804 (+3.1%) and query_cli +76,672 (+2.6%) for the page index, query_join +984, query_streaming_agg +2,368 and query_streaming_agg_fused +388. Everything beyond those numbers predates the change and had accumulated since the 2026-08-05 record.
